slides.title: Take space. Don't *disappear*.
slides.sub: There's a difference, and they can feel it.

slides.title: Space has an end.
slides.body: "I need an hour. I'll call you at 8." They know you're coming back, and when.

slides.title: Disappearing doesn't.
slides.body: Going quiet with no word leaves the other person guessing. Guessing usually fills in the worst.

slides.title: Then keep the 8.
slides.body: Coming back when you said you would is what makes asking for space safe next time.

slides.title: Write your sentence now.
slides.body: Before the next hard moment: what you need, how long, and when you'll be back.
